name: audio-preview-vscode
description: Play WAV, MP3, FLAC, Ogg, Opus and M4A in VS Code with a waveform, spectrogram, A-B loop and LUFS loudness. Offline.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: The ffmpeg fallback is off in untrusted workspaces.

audioPreview.maxWavMB.description: WAV files are streamed in 2 MB chunks for the waveform, spectrogram and loudness. Larger files only play and show their header.

audioPreview.maxDecodedMB.description: MP3, FLAC, Ogg, Opus and M4A files are decoded whole in the webview. If the decoded samples would be larger than this, the file only plays and shows its header. 600 MB is about 28 minutes of 44.1 kHz stereo.

audioPreview.maxRemoteFileMB.description: Files in remote or virtual workspaces are read whole. Larger files show a message.

audioPreview.ffmpegPath.description: Your own ffmpeg, used only when you click 'Decode with ffmpeg' on a file VS Code cannot decode (for example AAC in M4A). Nothing is bundled or downloaded.

audioPreview.askForRating.description: Ask one time for a Marketplace rating after you have used Audio Preview for a few days. You can answer "Later" or "Don't ask again". Nothing is sent anywhere.

audioPreview.showSupportLinks.description: Show the small Sponsor and More free viewers links at the bottom of the audio view. The change shows in files you open next. Nothing is sent anywhere.

walkthroughs.title: Get started with Audio Preview
walkthroughs.description: Play audio files, set a loop and read their loudness without leaving VS Code.

steps.title: Open an audio file
steps.description:
Click a .wav, .mp3, .flac, .ogg, .opus or .m4a file in the Explorer. It opens with the header, tags, waveform and spectrogram.
[Find an audio file](command:workbench.action.quickOpen?%5B%22.wav%22%5D)

media.altText: A FLAC file open in Audio Preview with waveform, spectrogram, loop region and loudness.

steps.title: Loop a region and change speed
steps.description: Drag across the waveform to set a loop, or press [ and ] at the playhead. Pick a speed from 0.25x to 2x; the pitch stays the same.

steps.title: Read the loudness
steps.description: The Loudness panel shows integrated, short-term and momentary LUFS, sample peak, RMS and clipped samples. Copy stats puts them on the clipboard.

steps.title: Limits and the ffmpeg fallback
steps.description:
Set the size limits for large files, and the path of your own ffmpeg for AAC files.
[Open settings](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%5B%22audioPreview%22%5D)

scripts.package: npm run build && npx -y @vscode/vsce package --no-dependencies -o dist/
